title: List Of Public Organizations In Shanghai

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 4683 Date October 8. 1938）
Subject List of Public Organizations in Shanghai.
Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Forwarded herewith is an up-to-date list of
public bodies situated in the International Settlement
and French Concession compiled up to the end of September,
1938. They have been classified and placed in the
following categories and arranged according to Police
Districts :-
1. Political Organizations, with an appendix showing the
branches of the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation which have closed temporarily.
2. Trade associations and labour unions.
3. Guilds, Fellow Countrymen's Associations, Benevolent
Societies, etc.
4. Public organizations in the French Concession.

（批：D.C. (Sp. Br.) CIR P.A. Keep a file for ref D.B.R. 10/10.）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 11 OCT. 1938 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）
C. Crawford
D. I.
D.C. (Special Branch)
Commr
for
Information.
Jno Robertson
DC(SB)
（批：F1 C. 2/10）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.1，特别科
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别科登记处 编号 S. B. D. 4683 日期 1938年10月8日）
事由：上海各公共团体名单。
由督察长克劳福德编制并呈送

兹随文呈送一份截至1938年9月底编制的、位于公共租界和法租界的公共团体的最新名单。这些团体已分类归入以下类别，并按警区排列：-
1. 政治组织，附录列示暂时关闭的第一特区市民联合会各分会。
2. 同业公会和工会。
3. 会馆、同乡会、慈善团体等。
4. 法租界内的公共组织。

（批：副督察长（特别科）抄送巡官存档。供副局长参考归档。10/10。）
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1938年10月11日 总办办公室）
C. 克劳福德
督察长

A list of political organizations, labour
unions, trade associations, guilds, fellow countrymen's
associations and benevolent societies in the Settlement
classified according to Police District and containing
statistics of membership, etc. is submitted herewith.

I respectfully suggest that Stations be
asked to submit to the Officer i/c Special Branch
any alterations which occur from time to time in
organizations in their respective districts so that
the necessary corrections may be made to the list and
in this connection a draft Memorandum for issue to
Stations is submitted with this report. An up-to-date
list could be submitted yearly.

for distribution.

R. W. Mac Adie

DRAFT
---------

Memorandum

List of Various Organizations in the Settlement

To Officers i/c Stations,

It is imperative that any alterations
wich occur from time to time in various organizations
in your district should be submitted through the
usual channels to the Officer i/c Special Branch.

In this connection the fcllowing
important changes should always be reported :-

(1) Change of Address.
(N.B. - The new address should always be
given)

(2) Alteration of street numbers.

(3) Change of Chairmanship of a body.

(4) Organizations closing down or dying out
through lack of support, financial reasons
or other causes.

A list of political, socio
labour unions, trade associations,
guilds and benevolent societies
which was recently compiled
up to date is attached
herewith.

d.b (Davis)

备忘录

租界内各类组织名单

致各巡捕房主管警官，

务必通过常规渠道，将贵辖区内各类组织不时发生的任何变动报送特别处主管警官。

在此方面，应始终报告以下重要变更：-

(1) 地址变更。
（注意 - 必须提供新地址）

(2) 门牌号变更。

(3) 机构负责人变更。

(4) 因缺乏支持、财务原因或其他原因而关闭或消亡的组织。

最近编制的截至目前的政治、社会、
工会、同业公会、
会馆及慈善团体名单
附后。

d.b (Davis)
